<script>
    let isRegisterSuccess = false;
    let deferredPrompt = null; // 用来保存事件
    var isFinishInstall = localStorage.getItem('isFinishInstall') === "1";
    // const installBtn = document.getElementById('installBtn');

    // 监听 beforeinstallprompt 事件
    window.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault(); // 阻止自动弹出
        deferredPrompt = e; // 保存事件
        // installBtn.style.display = 'block'; // 显示安装按钮
    });

    window.addEventListener('appinstalled', e => {
        isFinishInstall = true;
        deferredPrompt = null;
        localStorage.setItem('isFinishInstall', "1"); // 存储数据
    });

    // 点击按钮触发安装提示

    //         deferredPrompt = null;
    //         installBtn.style.display = 'none'; // 隐藏按钮
    //     });
    // });

    function downloadPwa() {
        if (!isFinishInstall) {
            // 注册 Service Worker
            if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
            } else {
                alert("open url in chrome")
                return;
            }
            if (!isRegisterSuccess) {
                alert("pwa init error")
            }
            if (!deferredPrompt) return;

            deferredPrompt.prompt(); // 显示安装提示
            deferredPrompt.userChoice.then((choice) => {
                if (choice.outcome === 'accepted') {
                    // console.log('用户接受了安装');
                } else {
                    // console.log('用户取消了安装');
                }
                deferredPrompt = null;
            });
        } else {
            alert("already install")
            // let h5_url = 'https://vegascash7.com/index.html?channelId='+channelId+'&childChannel='+childChannel+'&platform=h5_pwa';
            // window.open(h5_url)
        }

    }

    // 注册 Service Worker
    if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
        navigator.serviceWorker.register('./static/service-worker.js')
            .then((reg) => {
                console.log('SW registered', reg);
                isRegisterSuccess = true;
            })
            .catch((err) => {
                console.error('SW registration failed:', err);
                isRegisterSuccess = false;
            });
    }
</script>
